description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small nature props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: round leafy green bush, green bush with small pink flowers, mossy green boulder, gray rock, cut tree stump, cluster of three glowing light-blue mushrooms, small herb plant with silver-white serrated leaves, green fern, patch of tiny yellow and white wildflowers, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, front-facing view. Do not draw this house or tree.
